name: Câmara dos Deputados Dados Abertos API

provider.name: Câmara dos Deputados (Brazilian Chamber of Deputies)

summary: Keyless REST API for the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies: deputies, parties, bills, votes, events, committees and parliamentary expenses.
description: The Dados Abertos API exposes deputies (with party, state and legislature), parties and blocs, propositions (bills) and their processing, roll-call votes, committee and plenary events, and the expense reports (cota parlamentar) of each deputy. Lists are paginated and returned with HATEOAS links; JSON is the default and XML is available through the Accept header.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented; every response carries a Retry-After: 30 header (observed on 200 responses).

endpoints.summary: Deputies, filterable by name, party, state and legislature

license.name: Not stated on the pages fetched

coverage.temporal: Current legislature, with history for earlier ones

agent_notes: Docs and field names are in Portuguese. Take pagination from the links array in the body or from the Link and X-Total-Count headers; itens=1000 was accepted on /deputados. Default list size is small, so pass itens. Send Accept: application/xml for XML; formato=csv returned 406.
caveats: No data licence was found on the portal pages checked.
Retry-After: 30 is sent on successful responses; it is not an error signal.
A swagger.json path returns 405; the working OpenAPI document is /api/v2/api-docs.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; proposicoes, votacoes, eventos and despesas also answered 200.
